findings.evidence: `Comodule.Hom.ker f` is defined as `(⊥ : Subcomodule R C N).comap f` in `Subcomodule/Comap.lean` lines 253-255; the general comap lemmas are in this file lines 55-68, but the kernel proofs repeat `IsNoetherian.noetherian` at lines 78-90.
findings.fix: Prove the kernel lemmas by unfolding `Comodule.Hom.ker` and applying `Subcomodule.comap_finite_of_isNoetherian` / `Subcomodule.comap_finite_of_finite` to `⊥`, rather than repeating the module-theoretic proof.

summary: The new finiteness facts are at the right mathematical level for comaps, but the PR also adds special-case range/kernel proofs instead of deriving them from the existing general map/comap API.
